Infimal convolution in each connected finite degree graph proves graph BUC = uniform closure of graph-Lipschitz arrays. For d=2 an exact beta-integral comparison gives the arcsine metric bounds; the separation examples are verified against Theorem 3.2 of the source. The accompanying finite verifier checks algebraic specializations but does not prove the infinite-dimensional argument.

value.rationale: The statement supplies an exact new structural matrix criterion for every bounded diagonal in a published open nonabelian operator-action problem, with a natural canonical edge geometry and explicitly quantified two-coordinate arcsine-angle equivalence. Opposite counterexamples show neither Toeplitz nor full rotation norm-continuity dominates the other even on a particularly natural diagonal subclass. These geometric and algebraic distinctions motivate the exact question independently of computational reproducibility or novelty.
